technical.summary: Strong trend structure with golden cross and price above all MAs, but extreme overbought conditions across multiple oscillators with stochastic bearish cross create significant pullback risk; entry timing is poor despite bullish setup.

fundamental.summary: CCI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 13 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear (36 Fear/Greed) with bearish AAII sentiment (41.4%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of insider conviction and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (384.8), flat yield curve, and earnings in 13 days create severe macro headwinds for real estate sector; credit stress likely elevated.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross with price above all major MAs and strong ADX trend structure provides directional conviction, supported by fear-zone contrarian opportunity (36 Fear/Greed index).
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions across RSI-9 (95.01), RSI-14 (89.93), stochastic bearish cross, and MFI combined with crisis VIX, high earnings risk in 13 days, and zero fundamental support create imminent pullback risk that outweighs trend strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross and price above all major MAs provide trend structure, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI-9 95.01, stochastic bearish cross) create imminent pullback risk that negates entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis VIX (384.8), earnings in 13 days, and overbought oscillators across all indicators create severe macro headwinds with high probability of sharp pullback before earnings volatility.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
